    Pyrifos: Planned Mixed-Design Contrasts

    pyrifos-mixed-contrasts.Rmd

    The vegan::pyrifos data contain repeated aquatic-community observations from 12 experimental ditches. Dose was assigned to ditches, so planned dose comparisons must use ditch centroids and a between-ditch denominator. Treating 132 dates as independent replicates would test the wrong experimental unit.

    data(pyrifos, package = "vegan")
ditch <- gl(12, 1, length = 132)
week <- factor(rep(c(-4, -1, 0.1, 1, 2, 4, 8, 12, 15, 19, 24), each = 12))
dose <- factor(rep(c(0.1, 0, 0, 0.9, 0, 44, 6, 0.1, 44, 0.9, 0, 6), 11))
keep <- week %in% c(1, 2, 4, 8)

community <- pyrifos[keep, ]
environment <- data.frame(
  ditch = droplevels(ditch[keep]),
  dose = droplevels(dose[keep])
)
design <- compile_permanova_design(
  ~ dose + (1 | ditch), environment,
  vegdist(community, method = "bray")
)

    The first planned contrast compares the mean of all positive-dose levels with the control level. Coefficients name every dose level and sum to zero.

    dose_levels <- levels(environment$dose)
positive_vs_control <- setNames(
  ifelse(dose_levels == "0", -1, 1 / (length(dose_levels) - 1)),
  dose_levels
)

planned <- permanova_mixed_contrasts(
  design,
  contrasts = list(`positive mean - control` = positive_vs_control),
  permutations = 199,
  seed = 20260719
)
planned
#> Mixed-design distance contrasts
#> Design: balanced random intercept 
#> Estimand: equally weighted random-intercept unit centroids 
#> Denominator: MS[ditch within treatment model] 
#>                 contrast                                         estimand df
#>  positive mean - control equally weighted random-intercept unit centroids  1
#>         ss                      denominator denominator_df pseudo_f p_perm
#>  0.1626667 MS[ditch within treatment model]              7 4.763559  0.005
#>  p_adjusted adjustment
#>       0.005       holm

    The returned estimand and denominator make the unit contract inspectable.

    with(planned$tests[[1]], list(
  estimand = estimand,
  denominator = denominator$expression,
  exchangeable_units = exchangeable_units,
  permutation_algorithm = permutation_algorithm
))
#> $estimand
#> [1] "equally weighted random-intercept unit centroids"
#> 
#> $denominator
#> [1] "MS[ditch within treatment model]"
#> 
#> $exchangeable_units
#> [1] "ditch"
#> 
#> $permutation_algorithm
#> [1] "contrast-specific Freedman-Lane permutation of whole random-intercept units"

    All dose pairs can be generated with a multiplicity adjustment. Holm is the default strong familywise procedure.

    pairs <- permanova_mixed_pairwise(
  design, adjust = "holm", permutations = 199, seed = 20260719
)
pairs$table[, c("contrast", "pseudo_f", "p_perm", "p_adjusted")]
#>            contrast pseudo_f p_perm p_adjusted
#> 0 - 0.1     0 - 0.1 1.007013  0.425      0.850
#> 0 - 0.9     0 - 0.9 1.559877  0.165      0.495
#> 0 - 6         0 - 6 4.539794  0.005      0.050
#> 0 - 44       0 - 44 8.491707  0.005      0.050
#> 0.1 - 0.9 0.1 - 0.9 1.073182  0.425      0.850
#> 0.1 - 6     0.1 - 6 2.413008  0.020      0.120
#> 0.1 - 44   0.1 - 44 5.561288  0.005      0.050
#> 0.9 - 6     0.9 - 6 2.213929  0.045      0.225
#> 0.9 - 44   0.9 - 44 5.107532  0.005      0.050
#> 6 - 44       6 - 44 1.844877  0.080      0.320

    The same interface supports top-level contrasts in a balanced nested hierarchy, treatment-cell contrasts in a declared randomized-block model, and treatment-profile contrasts in the balanced region/site hybrid. It rejects unbalanced mixed layouts and lower-level nested treatments: those need a separately validated experimental-unit and exchangeability contract.
